title: signing fns return String not SigningError
description: signing.rs: load_signing_key, load_signing_key_from_bytes, write_signing_key all return Result<_, String> instead of Result<_, SigningError>. This inconsistency means callers cannot pattern-match on error variants, the errors are incompatible with the ? operator when the enclosing function returns SigningError, and the stringly-typed errors bypass the SigningError Display impl. Idiomatic Rust would use the existing SigningError type (adding a variant for IO/permission errors if needed) and impl From<SigningError> for UsenetIpfsError is already in place.
